author: Goggins
text: We all have the ability to be more than we are.

author: Goggins
text: You are stopping you, you are giving up instead of getting hard.

author: Goggins
text: The most important conversation is the one you have with yourself.

author: Goggins
text: If you can get through doing things that you hate to do, on the other side is greatness.

author: Goggins
text: Pain unlocks a secret doorway in the mind, one that leads to both peak performance and beautiful silence.

author: Goggins
text: You have to build calluses on your brain just like how you build calluses on your hands. Callus your mind through pain and suffering.

author: Goggins
text: When you think you are done, you're only at 40 percent of your body's capability.

author: Goggins
text: Motivation is crap. Motivation comes and goes. When you're driven, whatever is in front of you will get destroyed.

author: Goggins
text: Everything in life is a mind game. Whenever we get swept under by life's dramas, large and small, we forget that.

author: Goggins
text: Be more than motivated, be more than driven, become literally obsessed to the point where people think you're f***ing crazy.

author: Goggins
text: You are in danger of living a life so comfortable and soft that you will die without ever realizing your true potential.

author: Goggins
text: The only way that you can endure your pain is to say 'I'm in pain, but I don't care.' That's the mindset.

author: Goggins
text: Most people who are criticizing and judging haven't even tried what you failed at.

author: Goggins
text: No matter what you do in life, you will always have fear. The question is, are you going to let it control you?

author: Goggins
text: Suffering is the true test of life.

author: Goggins
text: The only thing that will ever make you great is doing the things that are uncomfortable.

author: Goggins
text: A lot of us don't know about another world that exists for us because it's on the other side of suffering.

author: Goggins
text: I don't stop when I'm tired. I stop when I'm done.

author: Goggins
text: The mind is the most powerful weapon. Use it.

author: Goggins
text: We live in a world where mediocrity is celebrated. Don't let that be you.

author: Goggins
text: Denial is the ultimate comfort zone.

author: Goggins
text: You are not special. Nobody cares. Work harder.

author: Goggins
text: It's possible to transcend anything that doesn't kill you.

author: Goggins
text: The most dangerous person on earth is the reformed man.

author: Goggins
text: The only limitation you have is the one you set yourself.

author: Goggins
text: Nobody is going to come and save you. You've got to save yourself.

author: Goggins
text: I'm not talented. I'm obsessed.

author: Goggins
text: Champions are not the ones who always win races—champions are the ones who get out there and try.

author: Goggins
text: Comfort zones are where dreams go to die.

author: Goggins
text: The most important thing in the world is discipline. Without it, you have nothing.

author: Goggins
text: What if the person you're trying to become is on the other side of the suffering?

author: Goggins
text: Life is one long mental journey. Every day you have to earn it.

author: Hormozi
text: The only way to predict the future is to create it.

author: Hormozi
text: You don't need more time. You need less bullshit.

author: Hormozi
text: The best marketing in the world is a product that works.

author: Hormozi
text: People don't buy products. They buy better versions of themselves.

author: Hormozi
text: Clarity removes fear. Most people are scared because they don't know what they want.

author: Hormozi
text: The market doesn't care about your feelings, your potential, or your excuses. It rewards performance.

author: Hormozi
text: Volume solves a lot of problems people think are skill problems.

author: Hormozi
text: The fastest way to succeed is to be relentlessly consistent.

author: Hormozi
text: Boring is underrated. Most people want to be interesting. Rich people want to be boring and consistent.

author: Hormozi
text: If you're not embarrassed by your first product, you launched too late.

author: Hormozi
text: The problem isn't that you fail. The problem is you stop trying after you fail.

author: Hormozi
text: Rich people solve problems. Poor people complain about them.

author: Hormozi
text: You will never outperform your own self-image.

author: Hormozi
text: The most important thing you can do is finish what you start.

author: Hormozi
text: Success is the progressive realization of a worthy goal.

author: Hormozi
text: Your work ethic is the one thing no one can take from you and no one can beat you at if you choose not to be beaten.

author: Hormozi
text: Most people overestimate what they can do in a day and underestimate what they can do in a decade.

author: Hormozi
text: Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.

author: Hormozi
text: The gap between where you are and where you want to be is filled with work.

author: Hormozi
text: Stop trying to be interesting. Start being interested in getting better.

author: Hormozi
text: Nothing changes if nothing changes. You have to do something different to get something different.

author: Hormozi
text: The hard part isn't knowing what to do. It's doing it when you don't feel like it.

author: Hormozi
text: You can't build a reputation on what you're going to do.

author: Hormozi
text: Execution is the only strategy that matters.

author: Hormozi
text: You can have excuses or you can have results, but you can't have both.

author: Hormozi
text: Your habits determine your future. Change your habits, change your life.

author: Hormozi
text: Don't wait for the right moment. The right moment is when you decide to make it right.

author: Hormozi
text: Average effort produces average results. Extraordinary effort produces extraordinary results.

author: Hormozi
text: Do the work nobody else wants to do. Get the results nobody else has.

author: Hormozi
text: The compounding effect of daily discipline is the most powerful force in the universe.

author: Hormozi
text: If you want to be in the top 1%, you need to do what the bottom 99% aren't willing to do.

author: Hormozi
text: Stop negotiating with yourself. Decide and execute.

author: Warren Buffett
text: Do not save what is left after spending, but spend what is left after saving.
source: Berkshire Hathaway shareholders meeting (widely reported, e.g. Yahoo Finance)
